schemas.title: PartFacts
schemas.description: Canonical, kernel-measured facts about a single solid produced by executing a printspec on a real CAD kernel (OpenCascade/OCCT via brepjs or cadquery). PartFacts is an OUTPUT artifact -- it is produced by a closed-source engine that runs geometry; this schema only defines and validates the shape of that output and is versioned independently of the printspec document schema. Every numeric field documents its unit and a precision note describing how the value was measured and to what tolerance it should be trusted.
